lines.t: Morning breaks with your glow so bright
You paint the day in a golden light
Without your spark, we fade to grey
You're the music in every sway
Without you it all falls apart
No rhythm, no beat, no spark
You're the sun, the moon, the fire inside
Without you we just can't survive
You're the laughter in a crowded room A flower that refuses to lose its bloom
You're the reason for the stars above The echo of an endless love
Every hour, every second Every glance with you here, life's a dance
Without you it all falls apart No rhythm, no beat, no spark
You're the sun, I'm on the fire inside Without you, we just can't survive
You're the pages in my storybook
You're the dream that I can't shake
The best decision I'll ever make
